text: Bitcoin is outpacing Ethereum today with a 2.1% gain versus 0.3%, while Bitcoin dominance sits elevated at 58.8%, suggesting investors are favoring the largest asset over alternatives. The Fear & Greed index at 72 reflects greed conditions that have held steady over the week, consistent with modest upward momentum across major assets and $108B in daily volume. Broader altcoin action—with Solana and BNB trailing Bitcoin's performance—indicates selective strength rather than broad risk-on sentiment.
